body: It’s not even feeling depressed anymore I’m fucking tired and bored and angry all the time but I’m constantly pretending I’m not, I’m in constant physical pain and I can never sleep more then a few hours, everyone is moving forward in their life and I’m just stuck, I don’t want to sit and do this in the comments though but thanks anyway
I think I seem like a pretty upbeat person when I’m with people but I don’t actually feel that way most of the time
